verdict.rationale: Foreloop lets users submit feedback via a widget and routes it into projects/intentions, giving PMs some visibility into raw feedback and its origin, but the docs never describe surfacing customer context (e.g. user profile, usage, segment, or account data) alongside that feedback for prioritization. Missing for 10: explicit customer/account context fields tied to feedback, prioritization scoring or dashboards, and any evidence of merging CRM/usage data with feedback.
